name: goldilocks
description: A lean Superpowers-compatible workflow suite with dynamic process depth and constant quality standards.

interface.longDescription: Provides thirteen familiar workflow entry skills plus a Goldilocks router backed by six shared progressive-disclosure engines and an on-demand continuity protocol. It preserves brainstorming, planning, specs, debugging memory, TDD, worktrees, delegation, review, verification, handoff, branch finishing, and skill-writing coverage while keeping Direct work free of ceremony.
defaultPrompt: Use the smallest workflow that preserves full quality.
Plan and execute this without unnecessary process overhead.
Replace a Superpowers workflow with the equivalent Goldilocks entry.
